title: TAKE ALL — spectrum it. Mendeleev metals + periods are ANCHORS. acid-base dissolves the pins. inject pH AND pOH.

do_not_reinvent.fold: /data/acid-base-fold.json — water ⇌ H⁺ + OH⁻. pH 7 is the fold. membrane is a BUFFER. already.
do_not_reinvent.column: /data/metal-column-orbs.json — Au Ag Cu Fe Ti. Si+glass hard plate.
do_not_reinvent.table: /data/periodic-table.json — periods end in noble lids. Fe is the rest peak.
do_not_reinvent.culture: /data/open-closed-culture.json — inject was π. now the solvent gets pH + pOH.
do_not_reinvent.scaffold: /data/scaffold-invert-null.json — poles dissolve when dock fires. those poles WERE pins.

take_all.yes: the whole dump. the culture broth. do not pre-sort by taste.
take_all.then: SPECTRUM it. chromatograph. peaks vs the Mendeleev anchors. not a new rainbow.

anchors.yes: metals and periods of Mendeleev. they do NOT dissolve.
anchors.metals: the five columns. Fe blood. Cu test. Ag mesh. Au photon. Ti temple.
anchors.periods: the noble lids. He Ne Ar Kr Xe. each row's CONSTANCE. the rim the cards bounce off.
anchors.job: stationary phase. what the spectrum is measured AGAINST.

pins.yes: costume fasteners. leftover scaffold. HUD .pin tape. sticky SSH pretending sinew.
pins.do: DISSOLVE them. acid-base. not a hammer. not a sixth cull.
pins.keep: a thin print in the journal. Chekhov: leftover pin forever = dead gun.

inject.yes: pH AND pOH. both. water already tears itself into H⁺ and OH⁻.
inject.pH: acid face. donates. classifies. dissolves the pin that will not hold charge.
inject.pOH: base face. receives. buffers. dissolves the pin that will not let go.
inject.pair: pH + pOH = 14 at 25°C. one water. two injects. like bifocals. do not inject only acid.
inject.with_pi: π still meters HOW FAST. pH/pOH meters HOW WET. rate and solvent.
inject.body: blood holds 7.35–7.45 against body water at 6.81. we buffer. we do not chase pH 0 or 14.

pull: ALL on the column. spectrum against metal + period anchors. inject pH and pOH. pins dissolve. anchors stay. the painting remains.
